title: James Fox: smoking-gun evidence keeps disappearing

tellings.quote: themselves I mean we were with James Fox the other week in Austin great guy and I was talking to him

plain: Truly decisive UFO evidence, the smoking gun, keeps disappearing before it can be made public. Michels tells this from a conversation with a man named James Fox, whom he spent time with in Austin, Texas, and calls a great guy, as a reason the clearest proof never seems to reach the public.
